# Kongto Technology (江图科技) — cncdisplay.com

> Industrial CNC CRT-to-LCD display retrofit specialist since 2013.
> Founded 2013, Shenzhen, China. 500+ enterprise clients across USA, Germany,
> UK, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, India, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Philippines.
> Factory direct manufacturer — no middleman markup.

## Core Expertise
CRT-to-LCD retrofit modules for legacy CNC display systems across all major brands.
Plug-and-play replacement using original connectors and mounting. No CNC parameter
changes required. Custom solutions for non-standard signal interfaces available.

## CNC Brands Covered
- FANUC: A61L series (0093, 0094, 0092, 0096, 0097, 0090, 0074, 0086, 0072, 0076, 0095), 0-M, 0-T, 0i, 16i, 18i, 21i, OM-D, A02B series
- Mitsubishi: MDT962B, BM09DF, FCUA-CT100, MDT925PS, MDT947B, C-3470, C-5470, MDT-1283B
- Siemens: SINUMERIK 6FC5103, 6FC3988, 6FC3998, 6FC5203, SM0901, 840D, 810D, 850/880
- Mazak: Mazatrol M-32, T-32, CD1472, MDT1283B, C5470NS, DR5614, AIQA8DSP40
- Okuma: OSP5000, OSP5020, OSP7000, OSP500L-G
- Haas: VF Series, 28HM-NM4, 9-pin monochrome
- Heidenhain: TNC 310/320/410/415/425/430, BC110, BE211, BE411
- Toshiba: D9MM-11A, D14CM-01A, D15CM-04A
- Matsushita: KF-M7099H, TX-1450AB
- Other: Totoku, NUM, FAGOR, KME, Delem, Planeta (KBA)
